name: electron-p2p-media-sdk
description: Production-grade Electron P2P Media SDK and Application

scripts.build: tsc --emitDeclarationOnly && esbuild src/main/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --outfile=dist/main/index.js --external:electron && esbuild src/preload/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --outfile=dist/preload/index.js --external:electron && esbuild src/renderer/index.ts --bundle --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --outfile=dist/renderer/index.js && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist/renderer', {recursive: true}); require('fs').copyFileSync('src/renderer/index.html', 'dist/renderer/index.html');"
